fit.title: fee earnings and components
fit.reason: Brookfield Asset Management’s 2025 corporate arrangement changed the ownership and predecessor reporting basis. Common-share value requires separate fee earnings, carried-interest allocations, consolidated-fund interests and preferred/redeemable noncontrolling claims. The arrangement gave BAM full common ownership of the Asset Management Company; it does not imply all consolidated earnings or capital claims belong to BAM common shares.
fit.caution: Brookfield Asset Management’s 2025 corporate arrangement changed the ownership and predecessor reporting basis. Common-share value requires separate fee earnings, carried-interest allocations, consolidated-fund interests and preferred/redeemable noncontrolling claims. The arrangement gave BAM full common ownership of the Asset Management Company; it does not imply all consolidated earnings or capital claims belong to BAM common shares.
